review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for the original pending-decision case. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, DEC-001, repository identity/base commit, and paired-case identity agree across the specification and Gold. DEC-001 materially changes reentrancy behavior and remains unresolved; AC-001 is explicitly conditional and does not authorize selecting OPT-1. B must therefore stop at decisions with requirement-decision-pending for DEC-001, without ready or assignable tasks. Empty task and assignment expectations are appropriate. The supplied policy places this deterministic gate before Scenario Coverage, so the empty team catalog and absence of an independent project Reviewer do not invalidate this earlier block. TASK-IMPLEMENT and TASK-VERIFY apply only after resolution, and the paired case or any fixed hypothetical C input is not a human Decision. The complete supplied source evidence supports src/index.ts as the maintained implementation/type-contract owner, with the two test files as verification scope. Package configuration, CI, ignore rules, and pinned upstream build-source evidence support treating root declarations and dist as generated outputs rather than separately maintained owners; root-importing tests require a rebuild before verification. Inspection consumers do not become mandatory edit owners. Gold and preview release-input fingerprints and model, policy, sampling, and budget fields agree as supplied. The source-manifest digest is separately identified from the release source digest, not asserted to be the same artifact. Historical preparation fields indicating unfinished freezing are superseded for this review by the supplied frozen preview/release inputs. I relied on the stated Service-calculated mechanical bindings; I did not independently recompute digests, execute code, review a candidate, or infer human confirmation. No material error or unresolved ambiguity was identified in this Gold expectation.
